_comment: Canonical branch-protection config for the `dev` branch. Authoritative source for scripts/branch-protection-apply.sh (follow-on per F-BRANCH-PROTECTION-DRIFT-WORKFLOW). Schema mirrors GitHub branch-protection REST API as of 2026-05-17.

required_status_checks._strict_rationale: Set to false per ADR-0124 to break the O(N^2) rebase cascade. The own-merge-queue (oya-foundry-vcs-review-mergequeue-kernel) handles ordering via file-overlap clustering; GitHub-side up-to-date enforcement is unnecessary and harmful at scale.
required_status_checks._app_id_overrides_rationale: GitHub contexts can auto-pin to the last app that set a check. The agent review gate also posts an explicit commit status named `oya-pr-review`, so this context must allow any app/status provider (`app_id=-1`) instead of pinning to GitHub Actions check-run app IDs.

_required_pull_request_reviews_rationale: GitHub human approving reviews are not the merge authority for `dev`; the required `oya-pr-review` status/check is. Keep this null so branch-protection re-application cannot recreate the hidden requiresApprovingReviews=true/count=0 blocker that stalls the next queue.
